description: Come out on Friday, September 18 at 6:30 p.m. to see The Main Event Band! Chair set up may begin as early as 4:00 p.m. This is a rescheduled date. The Peggy Hughes Summer Concert Series takes place every Friday from May 24 through September 6, 2026 at Town Center Park in Ocean Isle Beach. Bring a friend, bring a chair and get ready to dance!
title: Ocean Isle Beach Summer Concert Series

description: The Southport Fall Market series continues the tradition of “Home Grown &amp; Home Made,” in downtown Southport. Come shop locally sourced produce, goods, and handmade arts and crafts every Wednesday from September 23 until November 11 in Waterfront Park from 9:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m. The market operates rain or shine.
title: Southport Fall Market

description: Rock and roll into Fall with the Live &amp; Local: Market + Music event series! Fall in love with the Town of Oak Island this autumn as Oak Island continues the best of summer living all season long. On Saturday, October 3rd enjoy an evening of live music by the Denver Nixon Band, local food and craft vendors, and celebrating the coastal community! The market starts at 4:00 PM and the music starts at 6:00 PM.
title: Live & Local: Music + Market
